text:
tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Day 18 showed kitchen_table_k1 at 07:57, then coffee_table_l1 at 08:31. It swaps between kitchen and living within minutes. Do not rely on time-of-day heuristics; check both kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1, prioritizing the most recent known location.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Day 18 09:19 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of desk_b1. Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 was wrong. It seems to stay in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day locations.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Day 18 20:50 feedback showed dish_rack_k1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for evenings, but it moved to the dish rack. It moves between living, kitchen table, and dish rack. Check dish_rack_k1 for late evening locations.

mug_felix: Moves between living and kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning, coffee_table_l1 for other times.

book_felix: Inconsistent. I repeatedly guessed nightstand_b1 on Day 16 but it was at coffee_table_l1. The object stays in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Day 16 07:00 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1. It moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.

glass_felix: Inconsistent. Day 12 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, but Day 13 22:10 feedback showed nightstand_b1. It moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night locations.
